value.rationale: A complete exact integral arithmetic classification of a canonical line intersection module answers a natural reconstruction question and detects three inequivalent 3-primary structures invisible to each line orbit partition (4,4,4,4), with a second such ambiguity at eight length-two orbits. Distinguishes geometric incidence from mere splitting degrees; no downstream theorem is required for this natural complete invariant.
